records.title_fr: La croix de rubans de saint Patrick
records.reason: National Museum of Ireland and Galway City Museum document historical 17 March home-made crosses; no claim that this is universally current.

records.title_fr: La bougie de Noël dans les foyers irlandais
records.reason: Irish Folklore Collection and National Museum of Ireland support domestic Christmas candles; ghost stories and guaranteed blessings remain folklore.

records.title_fr: Le feu communautaire de la Saint-Jean-Baptiste
records.reason: Regional heritage inventory and a 2026 diocese programme document a local religious procession/fire; the event is locally announced, not automatically 23 or 24 June.
records.calendar_hint_en: Nativity of St John Baptist, 24 June; eve commonly 23 June

records.title_en: Decorating Easter eggs: pisanki and pysanky
records.title_fr: Décorer les œufs de Pâques : pisanki et pysanky
records.reason: Polish pisanki and Ukrainian pysanky have regional Christian and cultural contexts; decorating eggs is not their priestly blessing or a supernatural protective formula.
records.calendar_hint_en: Easter season; no independently established universal Holy Saturday decorating time
